scriptLines: gender = iif(lower(trim(gender)) == 'm' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'male', 'Male',   iif(lower(trim(gender)) == 'f' || lower(trim(gender)) == 'female', 'Female', toString(null())) )) ~> derivedColumn1

derivedColumn1 derive(date_of_birth = coalesce(   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'yyyy-MM-dd'),   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MM/dd/yyyy'),   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'dd-MMM-yyyy'),   toDate(trim(date_of_birth), 'MMMM dd, yyyy'),   iif(length(trim(date_of_birth)) == 8 && substring(trim(date_of_birth), 3, 1) == '-',     toDate(       left(trim(date_of_birth), 6) + iif(toInteger(right(trim(date_of_birth), 2)) >= 26, '19', '20') + right(trim(date_of_birth), 2),       'MM-dd-yyyy'     ),     toDate(null())   ) ),

phone_digits = iif(isNull(phone) || lower(trim(phone)) == 'unknown', toString(null()),   iif(length(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', '')) == 11 && startsWith(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', ''), '1'),     substring(regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', ''), 2, 10),     regexReplace(phone, '[^0-9]', '')   ) ),
email = lower(trim(   replace(     replace(       replace(         replace(email, ' at ', '@'),       ',', '.'),     'gmial.com', 'gmail.com'),   '..', '.') )),
derivedColumn2 derive(phone = iif(length(phone_digits) == 10,   '(' + substring(phone_digits, 1, 3) + ') ' + substring(phone_digits, 4, 3) + '-' + substring(phone_digits, 7, 4),   toString(null()) ),

insurance_provider = case(   isNull(insurance_provider) || trim(insurance_provider) == '', 'Uninsured',   instr(lower(insurance_provider), 'cigna') > 0, 'Cigna',   instr(lower(insurance_provider), 'aetna') > 0, 'Aetna',   instr(lower(insurance_provider), 'blue') > 0, 'Blue Cross',   instr(lower(insurance_provider), 'medicaid') > 0, 'Medicaid',   instr(lower(insurance_provider), 'medi') > 0, 'Medicare',   instr(lower(insurance_provider), 'united') > 0 || lower(trim(insurance_provider)) == 'uhc', 'UnitedHealth',   instr(lower(insurance_provider), 'self') > 0, 'Self-Pay',   trim(insurance_provider) )) ~> derivedColumn3
